title: Clinical Catalyst Radar Input
description: Pass biotech companies as "Company Name | TICKER". For each one the radar pulls ClinicalTrials.gov studies and PubMed papers (matched to the company by sponsor), pulls SEC Form 4 insider transactions by ticker, then scores how strongly an advancing clinical asset and insider buying line up.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: One entry per company, formatted "Company Name | TICKER". The name drives the ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor match and PubMed search; the ticker drives the Form 4 insider lookup. Example: ["Moderna | MRNA", "BioNTech | BNTX", "CRISPR Therapeutics | CRSP"].

insiderLookbackDays.title: Insider lookback (days)
insiderLookbackDays.description: How far back to read SEC Form 4 open-market buys and sells.

clinicalSinceDays.title: Clinical/research window (days)
clinicalSinceDays.description: Only count ClinicalTrials.gov studies and PubMed papers updated within this window. Defaults to 540 days (18 months) so the score reflects current momentum, not history.

trialsPerCompany.title: Trials per company
trialsPerCompany.description: How many ClinicalTrials.gov studies to pull per company for the clinical-progress signal.

papersPerCompany.title: Papers per company
papersPerCompany.description: How many PubMed papers to pull per company for the research-momentum signal.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Pull SEC Form 4 open-market buys/sells. Turn off to score clinical + research only.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Drop companies scoring below this convergence score (0 to 100). 0 keeps everything with any data.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy passed through to the SEC Form 4 child. The clinical/research child uses government APIs directly and needs no proxy.
